name: חילוק שברים – p/n ÷ q/m (באנגלית)
questiontext:
What is the value of:

\(\frac{{CT:0}}{{CT:1}} \div \frac{{CT:2}}{{CT:3}} = \) [[input:ans1]]
[[validation:ans1]]
generalfeedback:
Outline: Divide by a fraction by multiplying by its reciprocal, multiply the numerators and the denominators, and simplify.
Step 1 — Multiply by the reciprocal
To divide by a fraction, flip it (swap its numerator and denominator) and change the division sign to a multiplication:

\[ \frac{{{CT:0}}}{{{CT:1}}} \div \frac{{{CT:2}}}{{{CT:3}}}=\frac{{{CT:0}}}{{{CT:1}}} \times \frac{{{CT:3}}}{{{CT:2}}} \]

Step 2 — Multiply the numerators and the denominators

\[ \frac{{{CT:0}}}{{{CT:1}}} \times \frac{{{CT:3}}}{{{CT:2}}}=\frac{{{CT:0}}\times {{CT:3}}}{{{CT:1}}\times {{CT:2}}}=\frac{{{CT:4}}}{{{CT:5}}} \]

Step 3 — Simplify to lowest terms
[[if test="{{CT:8}}"]]The greatest common divisor of \({{CT:4}}\) and \({{CT:5}}\) is \({{CT:6}}\). Divide the numerator and denominator by \({{CT:6}}\):

\[ \frac{{{CT:4}}}{{{CT:5}}}=\frac{{{CT:4}}\div {{CT:6}}}{{{CT:5}}\div {{CT:6}}}={{CT:7}} \]

[[else]]The greatest common divisor of \({{CT:4}}\) and \({{CT:5}}\) is \(1\), so nothing cancels. [[/if]]The numerator and the denominator now have no common factor (their greatest common divisor is \(1\)), so the answer is in lowest terms:

\[ {{CT:7}} \]

on_true.feedback: It seems you have forgotten to swap the numerator and denominator.
